title: The Mistletoe Bough
author: Anthony Trollope
description: "The Mistletoe Bough" by Anthony Trollope is a short story that falls within the genre of fiction, specifically focusing on themes of love and social dynamics.
longDescription: Written during the Victorian era, the narrative weaves a tale of romantic misunderstandings and familial relationships, set in an English country estate during the Christmas season.

authorInfo.bio: Anthony Trollope (1815–1882) is the author of The Warden. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
